admission_or_exclusion_reason: Exact complete MG1655 reference assembly, selected solely because the reproducible screen supplies every required type I-E Cascade and fused-Cas3 marker. It is an encoded-protein-machinery candidate, not evidence of a CRISPR array, interference, phage defence, activity or phenotype.

Exact complete type-material assembly selected because the reproducible screen finds generic Cas1/Cas2 and partial type I-E marker evidence but lacks two jointly required Cascade components. It is a genomic Boolean-specificity control, not evidence that this strain lacks a CRISPR array, another CRISPR subtype, interference, defence or any phenotype.
